title: AFPS memory.added event data
description: CloudEvent `data` payload for `memory.added` — an append-only archive write emitted by the AFPS `note()` tool (@afps/memory).

content.description: Archive entry appended to the run actor's memory.

scope.description: AFPS persistence scope. Absent MUST be read as "actor" (per-actor isolation), never as "shared".

operationId.description: Idempotency key for the underlying write, stable across retries. Present when the runtime already committed the write through the platform command route, making this event an observation rather than the write itself.
